details: The problem is that when I open the Action Menu on my hand (I only have one hand/one controller) it doesn't move at all, I searched in tutorials but I couldn't find anyone to explain it so I am pretty sure this is a bug and should not be happening. The answer enable or disable the Flick Select option in my action menu it's not the solution. i can neither enable or disable the flick select option because literally the action menu pointer does not move when I try to move it from the touch pad of my controller. click and hold the menu button dosent work either, literally it dosent move even with an xbox controller. I did some research on the flick select option and it has nothing to do with my problem. I repeat that my problem (and probably the problem of other people in my situation) is that the action menu is unusable for at least people who have only one htc control or one hand. I have been having this problem for a long time. and just now I am complaining because I don't even have the option to explore the new features like the personal mirror or the chatbox. Because of this problem I feel very limited to what other people can do and in my current situation I don't even have the opportunity to have another controller for my VR headset.
title: I have only one hand and I cannot use the Action menu.
